subject: Admin rights on Windows to install?

messages.author: b912a2cc2bbed9ce
messages.subject: Admin rights on Windows to install?
parts:
You are using some kind of installer for the Windows version.   Does this mean that users need to be Admin on their box?  What if your company has restricted the registry or the Program Files directories?
 
Do you have an "unzippable" version that can just be placed anywhere, not necessarily "program files", by just unzipping?  Do you really, really need an installer?
 
Thanks, Michael
